title: Clipt: How I built a clipboard history app and keyboard for iOS.
subtitle: (It's complex than you think)
description: My journey building Clipt, an iOS clipboard manager with a focus on native feel and performance.
excerpt: How I built a clipboard manager that feels like a native part of iOS, from SwiftUI to SwiftData and the challenges of IPC.
intro: I did not want to create just another clipboard manager that sits in a list. I wanted to build something that felt like a native part of the OS, something that would make people wonder if Apple had finally built a clipboard manager into a future version of iOS.
